historical_archives.wolfram_replay_body: queue={{URLDownload[u],origin}}; seen={}; tms={}; zrecs={}; filesTotal=0; While[Length[queue]>0, item=First[queue];queue=Rest[queue]; zf=item[[1]];zp=item[[2]];zh=IntegerString[FileHash[zf,"SHA256"],16,64];If[MemberQ[seen,zh],Continue[]];AppendTo[seen,zh];d=CreateDirectory[];fs=ExtractArchive[zf,d];filesTotal+=Length[fs];AppendTo[zrecs,{zp,zh,Length[fs]}];Do[rel=StringDrop[f,StringLength[d]+1];If[StringEndsQ[f,".zip"],AppendTo[queue,{f,zp<>"!"<>rel}]];If[StringEndsQ[f,".tm"],AppendTo[tms,{f,zp<>"!"<>rel}]],{f,fs}]];groups=GatherBy[tms,FileHash[#[[1]],"SHA256"]&];recs=Table[t=First[g][[1]];s=StringReplace[Import[t,"Text"],RegularExpression["(?m)#.*$"]->""];rr=Select[StringSplit /@ StringSplit[s,"\n"],Length[#]>0&];valid=Length[rr]>0&&AllTrue[rr,Length[#]==5&&StringMatchQ[#[[1]],DigitCharacter..]&&MemberQ[{"0","1"},#[[2]]]&&MemberQ[{"0","1"},#[[3]]]&&MemberQ[{"L","R"},#[[4]]]&&StringMatchQ[#[[5]],DigitCharacter..]&];If[valid,st=DeleteDuplicates[rr[[All,1]]];valid=Length[rr]==2Length[st]&&Length[DeleteDuplicates[rr[[All,{1,2}]]]]==Length[rr]&&Length[Complement[DeleteDuplicates[rr[[All,5]]],st]]==1];{First[g][[2]],IntegerString[FileHash[t,"SHA256"],16,64],If[valid,Length[st],-1],Length[g]},{g,groups}];{Length[seen],filesTotal,Length[tms],Length[groups],If[Length[recs]>0,Counts[recs[[All,3]]],{}],Select[recs,0<#[[3]]<=194&],zrecs}

code.canonical_javascript: function canonical(t){let n=t.size,best=null,spans=0;for(let flip=0;flip<2;flip++)for(let mirror=0;mirror<2;mirror++)for(const root of t.keys()){let ids=new Map([[root,0]]),q=[root],sig=[];for(let p=0;p<q.length;p++){const r=t.get(q[p]);for(let s=0;s<2;s++){let[w,d,v]=r[s^flip];let target=n;if(t.has(v)){if(!ids.has(v)){ids.set(v,q.length);q.push(v);}target=ids.get(v);}sig.push(`${w^flip}${(d==="R")^mirror}${String(target).padStart(3,"0")}`);}}if(q.length!==n)continue;if(!flip&&!mirror)spans++;let key=sig.join("");if(best===null||key<best)best=key;}return{key:best,spans};}
code.parse_numeric_table_javascript: function parseTM(s){const rows=s.split(/\r?\n/).map(s=>s.replace(/#.*/,"").trim()).filter(Boolean).map(s=>s.split(/\s+/));if(rows.some(r=>r.length!==5||! /^\d+$/.test(r[0])||! /^[01]$/.test(r[1])||! /^[01]$/.test(r[2])||! /^[LR]$/.test(r[3])||! /^\d+$/.test(r[4])))return null;let t=new Map();for(const r of rows){let k=+r[0];if(!t.has(k))t.set(k,[]);t.get(k)[+r[1]]=[+r[2],r[3],+r[4]];}if(rows.length!==t.size*2||[...t.values()].some(x=>!x[0]||!x[1]))return null;const undefinedTargets=new Set([...t.values()].flatMap(r=>r.map(x=>x[2])).filter(q=>!t.has(q)));if(undefinedTargets.size!==1)return null;return t;}
code.sha256_ascii_javascript: function sha256(text){const bytes=Array.from(text,c=>c.charCodeAt(0));if(bytes.some(b=>b>127))throw Error("ASCII required");const bitlen=bytes.length*8;bytes.push(128);while(bytes.length%64!==56)bytes.push(0);for(let j=7;j>=0;j--)bytes.push(j>=4?0:(bitlen>>>(j*8))&255);const K=[0x428a2f98,0x71374491,0xb5c0fbcf,0xe9b5dba5,0x3956c25b,0x59f111f1,0x923f82a4,0xab1c5ed5,0xd807aa98,0x12835b01,0x243185be,0x550c7dc3,0x72be5d74,0x80deb1fe,0x9bdc06a7,0xc19bf174,0xe49b69c1,0xefbe4786,0x0fc19dc6,0x240ca1cc,0x2de92c6f,0x4a7484aa,0x5cb0a9dc,0x76f988da,0x983e5152,0xa831c66d,0xb00327c8,0xbf597fc7,0xc6e00bf3,0xd5a79147,0x06ca6351,0x14292967,0x27b70a85,0x2e1b2138,0x4d2c6dfc,0x53380d13,0x650a7354,0x766a0abb,0x81c2c92e,0x92722c85,0xa2bfe8a1,0xa81a664b,0xc24b8b70,0xc76c51a3,0xd192e819,0xd6990624,0xf40e3585,0x106aa070,0x19a4c116,0x1e376c08,0x2748774c,0x34b0bcb5,0x391c0cb3,0x4ed8aa4a,0x5b9cca4f,0x682e6ff3,0x748f82ee,0x78a5636f,0x84c87814,0x8cc70208,0x90befffa,0xa4506ceb,0xbef9a3f7,0xc67178f2];let H=[0x6a09e667,0xbb67ae85,0x3c6ef372,0xa54ff53a,0x510e527f,0x9b05688c,0x1f83d9ab,0x5be0cd19];const rr=(x,n)=>(x>>>n)|(x<<(32-n));for(let pos=0;pos<bytes.length;pos+=64){let w=new Array(64);for(let i=0;i<16;i++)w[i]=(bytes[pos+4*i]<<24)|(bytes[pos+4*i+1]<<16)|(bytes[pos+4*i+2]<<8)|bytes[pos+4*i+3];for(let i=16;i<64;i++){let a=w[i-15],b=w[i-2];w[i]=(w[i-16]+(rr(a,7)^rr(a,18)^(a>>>3))+w[i-7]+(rr(b,17)^rr(b,19)^(b>>>10)))|0;}let [a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h]=H;for(let i=0;i<64;i++){let t1=(h+(rr(e,6)^rr(e,11)^rr(e,25))+((e&f)^(~e&g))+K[i]+w[i])|0;let t2=((rr(a,2)^rr(a,13)^rr(a,22))+((a&b)^(a&c)^(b&c)))|0;h=g;g=f;f=e;e=(d+t1)|0;d=c;c=b;b=a;a=(t1+t2)|0;}H=H.map((v,i)=>(v+[a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h][i])|0);}return H.map(h=>(h>>>0).toString(16).padStart(8,"0")).join("");}
